name: ReStory
tagline: A wearable that recognises the people you talk to by face and voice and remembers what each conversation was about.

awards: Best Overall Sponsored By Vobile (1st, 2nd, & 3rd Place)

problem: People forget who they met and what was said.
solution: Captures face and voice embeddings to identify each contact, separates speakers in real time while isolating the wearer's voice, transcribes, and stores memories per person.
demo_moment: Team-described: the wearable identifies a returning contact and recalls the last talk.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Overall Sponsored By Vobile (1st, 2nd, & 3rd Place)” among 112 submissions.
Fuses face and voice signatures instead of relying on one.

lessons: Combining two weak signals makes identification robust enough to demo.
